page.layout: One page of running text, with the page number and running head at the top and a catchword at the lower right. No margin notes.

p.i: plus adversos seipsos quam Me pugnant, dum peccatis suis tuæ Iustitiæ, a divitiis aliorum Injuriis, à Numeris suis Tumultuantibus, & ab his Confusioni exponuntur.
Quanquam prompte admodum & alacriter in exitium meum coiverint, ne-, faxis, cum eorum ruina procumbam.

main_text.p: Fac ne nimis cogitando, vel quid Illi fecerint vel quæ Ipse (in initio præsertim) passus fuerim, immemor fiam Illius Servatoris mei Crucifixi, ut Ignorantia valeat in veniam Causa, & in ipsis Mortis angoribus ad Te precor, Domi-ne, Pater Ignosce quia ignorant quid faciunt.

p.i: Lachrymas quas negarunt mihi in calamito-sissima mea Fortuna, fac Tua Gratia ut pro se-ipsis profundant, qui quo minus pro Me doleant, eo impensius pro se debent ingemiscere.

main_text.p: O ne Sanguis Meus super Eos & Filios eorum, quos fraus nonnullorum & prava studia, non propria sua malitia ad Me Crucifigendum insti-gavit.

p.i: Tu vero Domine potes & velis Me per has meas (quemadmodum olim Redemptorem meum) per-pessiones exaltare simul & perficere, in quibus plus Misericordiæ tuæ quam Iustitiæ, vel humanæ sævitiæ agnosco.

page.notes: The italic setting of the body text was judged from the scan; Crucifixi and Crucifigendum appear in roman type. The bottom-right "27. Ad" is set larger and in a different style, so it is treated as a catchword; the "27." may be a section number. The hyphen in "ne-," and the word "olim" after "quemadmodum" are doubtful at the line ends. The long s in the body is written as plain s.
